summary: The directed adjacency list incorrectly inserted reverse edges into its adjacency matrix and queried rows using edge_count instead of node_count, producing incorrect adjacency results. The fix preserves edge direction and uses node_count consistently for matrix indexing. Reverse only these src/adj.rs changes. The fix-added test in tests/adjacency_matrix.rs exercises this behavior; in its five-node graph, the buggy lookup incorrectly reports adjacency from node 1 to node 0. This is a proposed comparison, not a reproduction result.
